title: PS5's QSSR upscaling lands in Spider-Man 2 and 5 more 🎮
subject: ps5
description:
Which game should get QSSR next? 👇

Sony confirmed six more PS5 games with Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), its new AI upscaling for the standard PS5: Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Control Resonant, Arc Raiders, The Finals, No Man's Sky and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam.

Sources: Video Games Chronicle (Nov 13, 2026), Digital Foundry (Oct 2026), GamesRadar+ (Nov 13, 2026)
Game footage © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Six more games now look sharper on the base PS5.
Sony confirmed them on November 13, all using its new AI upscaler, QSSR.
scenes.search: playstation controller close up blue light

scenes.text: It's built on the same foundation as PSSR on the PS5 Pro.
Insomniac says Spider-Man 2 is sharper and more stable in both Fidelity and Performance modes.
Control Resonant, Arc Raiders, The Finals, No Man's Sky and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam got it too.
Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei came first. Digital Foundry called the Wolverine boost exceptional.
